rules.assessment_sv: Källans tilldelning följer riktiga leaderlandningar; inre kontakter delas i grafen. Detektion av oläsliga eller missade etiketter är ännu ofullständig.

other_domains.note: All 24 JSON documents, including non-code rule tables and all original fields.
Original parsers/assignment helpers retained. Local grammar has its own implementation; not asserted equivalent.
11 active profiles, 5 archived profiles, 14 library references. Profile calibration ratios belong to a different engine; not blindly applied.
No claim of an equivalent automatic global rule promotion or model-training loop.
Byte-identical model at models/pipestudio-labels.onnx; optional label suggestions only.
Neither ZIP contains CVAT XML or annotation JSONL. Documentation refers to feedback/ground truth not included in the ZIPs.
107 raw XMLs retained, 1297 CVAT shapes with nested attributes and 9368 Bluebeam records. Not training or independent acceptance evidence.

policy: A related runtime file is not a claim of complete rule equivalence. Every source file is preserved/accounted for in manifest.json; this assessment identifies known semantic gaps.
